recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色下，一個模糊的大結節內有大量陽性小淋巴球，並可見多個由陽性細胞圍成的環狀結構包住中央未染色的大細胞（rosettes），這種包圍 LP 細胞的 T 細胞環是 NLPHL 的特徵線索。
features: Vague large nodule with increased density of positive small lymphocytes compared with the surrounding zone
Multiple ring-like rosettes of positive cells encircling larger unstained central cells within the nodule
Membranous red chromogen staining of small lymphocytes; negative background small lymphocytes outside the nodule
Scattered positive cells in the internodular areas and around small vessels
Specific antibody not labeled; the rosetting pattern is typical of PD-1 or CD57 T follicular helper cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low-to-medium power shows a vaguely nodular area containing an increased density of positive small lymphocytes. Within the nodule, positive small cells form multiple ring-like rosettes surrounding larger unstained cells, a pattern characteristic of T follicular helper cells (PD-1/CD57) rimming LP cells. Scattered positive cells are also present in the internodular zone. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; the specific marker should be confirmed from the case record and LP cells highlighted with CD20, PAX5, OCT2 or BOB1.

ddx.vs: PTGC nodules contain mantle-type small B cells with residual germinal center cells but lack LP cells ringed by PD-1+/CD57+ rosettes.
THRLBCL is diffuse with scattered large B cells in a CD8+ T-cell and histiocyte background that usually lacks residual follicular dendritic meshworks and PD-1+ rosettes.
LRCHL can show T-cell rosettes, but its HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and weak/negative for PAX5 with loss of OCT2/BOB1, unlike CD20+ LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma nodules are composed of neoplastic BCL2+ centrocytes and centroblasts without scattered large LP cells rimmed by rosettes.
